pictures.name: STA1-Agora
pictures.prompt: The marketplace of ancient Athens around 300 BCE, bustling with merchants, shoppers, donkeys and stalls of fruit and pottery. Along one side runs a long colonnade, a porch of columns with a roof, its back wall covered in great colorful painted murals. Bright gold sunlight, deep blue shade under the porch. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: STA2-Under-Columns
pictures.prompt: Under a long colonnade in ancient Athens, its back wall covered with huge faded paintings of ancient warriors and ships. Zeno of Citium, now a lean man in his fifties with a long neck and a greying beard, in a plain white cloak, walks slowly between the columns, talking, while a small mixed crowd follows and listens: a merchant, a young student, an old woman with a basket, a traveler. Gold light slanting between columns, deep blue shade. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

Bystanders roll their eyes. Warm gold light. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood.
